candidates.text: When a state public accommodations law and the Constitution collide, there can be no question which must prevail
candidates.speaker: Gorsuch
phrases: public accommodations law and the Constitution collide
candidates.reason: States the case's rule: the Free Speech Clause prevails over a public accommodations law that compels expression.

candidates.text: Were the rule otherwise, the better the artist, the finer the writer, the more unique his talent
candidates.speaker: Gorsuch
phrases: the more easily his voice could be conscripted
candidates.reason: Rejects the Tenth Circuit's unique-services rationale, the decisive move on strict scrutiny.

candidates.text: Today, the Court, for the first time in its history, grants a business open to the public a constitutional right to refuse to serve members of a protected class
candidates.speaker: Sotomayor
phrases: for the first time in its history, grants a business open to the public
candidates.reason: The dissent's central charge, at the heart of the progressive critiques in the brief.

candidates.text: But tolerance, not coercion, is our Nation's answer

phrases: tolerance, not coercion, is our Nation's answer
